messages:
Ivy Bryce: Hi everyone! I’m Ivy — started today on the platform team. Remote from Portland, usually online 9a–5:30p PT. :wave:
Ivy Bryce: I bake sourdough on weekends, run trails, and have a sleepy dog named Nova who will absolutely appear on camera at some point. :dog:
Ivy Bryce: My desk number for badge pickup is `P-14` per the onboarding doc. Quick q: anyone have favorite lunch spots near the SF office (or best Slack channel for in-person lunch meetups)?
Jonah Patel: Welcome, Ivy!! :tada: Portland represent. If you’re ever in SF, hit up Katsu-ya for ramen or GreenLeaf on 5th for quick bowls. There’s a weekly lunch meetup on Thu in #lunch-plans.
Mira Patel: Hi Ivy — welcome! :wave: I’m on infra but sit near platform folks. We usually do 12:30 tacos on Weds. Also if you want a plant partner, I have a spare pothos.
Sam: Hey Ivy — coffee preferences? We have a little drip station and a bean club. I can bring a bag next week. :coffee:
Ivy Bryce: @Sam oat milk latte please! Will trade freshly baked sourdough when I’m in SF. :bread:
Noor: Welcome! I’m on DevEx — ping me and I’ll add you to the #platform-team and onboarding checklist. Also FYI badge pickup is at reception, say you’re with Platform and they’ll ask for `P-14`.
welcome-bot: Reminder: New hire welcome lunch is scheduled Friday at 12:00 PM in the demo kitchen. RSVP with `yes` or `no` in this thread.
Ivy Bryce: RSVP: yes. Looking forward to meeting folks in person. Thanks for the tips and the warm welcome! :smile:
Jonah Patel: Nice — bring sourdough pics. Also Nova pics required. :dog::camera_flash:
Mira Patel: We’ll put you down for the plant swap list if you want!
Sam: Added to bean club list. I’ll DM shipping details.
Noor: Dropping links — onboarding handbook, desk map, and lunch channel: <https://intranet.redwood/policies/onboarding> <https://intranet.redwood/desk-map> <#lunch-plans>
Ivy Bryce: Thanks everyone — super excited to be here. 🙂
